question: Cloud Kicks wants support team leads to reset passwords and freeze users only for agents in their region. They must not access full Setup. What should the admin configure?
explanation: Delegated Administration lets selected users manage users in specific roles without full Setup access. Modify All Data is too broad. Role hierarchy controls record access, not user administration. Sharing rules share business records, not user admin capabilities.

question: Users should only log in during business hours and from corporate IP ranges. Where should this be configured?
explanation: Profile login hours and login IP ranges strictly control when and where users can log in. Network Access only trusts IPs for network-level behavior and does not fully replace profile restrictions. Session Settings manages sessions after login. Company Information stores org defaults.

question: A contractor needs access to a custom object for 60 days only. What is the best solution?
explanation: Permission set assignments can be time-limited. A temporary profile creates maintenance overhead. Manual sharing grants record access, not object permission. Public groups do not expire object permissions.

question: A company changes its default time zone in Company Information. What happens to existing users?
options: Only new users inherit the new default
answers: Only new users inherit the new default
explanation: Company defaults affect new user baseline settings. Existing users keep their own personal settings. Reports are not recalculated and users are not frozen by changing the default time zone.

question: An admin wants to restrict access to a custom object for most users but allow a few users to create and edit records. What should be used?
explanation: Permission sets grant extra access to selected users without changing everyone’s profile. Page layouts affect UI, record types change business processes and layout assignments, and compact layouts affect key field display.

question: A user cannot log in and Login History shows “Login Outside Valid Hours.” What should the admin review?
explanation: The login history message points directly to login-hour restrictions on the user's profile. Role hierarchy affects records, dashboard running user affects analytics, and field-level security affects field visibility.

question: Which two settings are controlled by profiles?
explanation: Profiles can enforce login hours and login IP ranges. Record ownership is record-level data ownership, and dashboard refresh schedule is dashboard configuration.

question: A manager needs access to records owned by users below them. OWD is Private. What feature commonly provides this?
explanation: Role hierarchy commonly grants managers access to records owned by users below them when organization-wide defaults are restrictive. Page layouts change UI, validation rules enforce data quality, and App Manager manages apps.

question: An admin wants to bundle several permission sets but remove one dangerous permission from the bundle. What should be used?
explanation: Muting permission sets remove selected permissions from a permission set group. Manual sharing is record sharing, queues hold work records, and login flows customize login behavior.

topic: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder
question: A field should show different picklist values based on another picklist. What should the admin configure?
explanation: A dependent picklist filters available values based on a controlling field. Record types alone do not create the dependency, formula fields calculate values, and validation rules block invalid saves but do not dynamically filter options.

topic: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder
question: A child record must be deleted automatically when its parent is deleted. Which relationship supports this?
explanation: Master-detail supports cascade delete from parent to child. Lookup relationships do not require child deletion, and external lookup or hierarchical relationships do not meet this requirement.

topic: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder
question: A custom object should appear in global search. What must be enabled?
explanation: Custom objects must have Allow Search enabled to appear in global search. Grant Access Using Hierarchies controls record visibility, feed tracking enables feeds, and field history tracking tracks field changes.

topic: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder
question: Sales users need different page layouts and picklist values for enterprise and SMB opportunities. What should be used?
explanation: Record types support different business processes, picklist values, and page layout assignments. Compact layouts change highlights, queues hold work, and public groups group users.

topic: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder
question: A field should only appear on the Lightning page when Stage equals Closed Lost. What should the admin use?
explanation: Dynamic Forms can show or hide fields based on record criteria. Approval processes route approvals, assignment rules assign records, and forecast settings affect forecasting.

topic: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder
question: Which two can be customized in Lightning App Builder?
explanation: Lightning App Builder controls page structure and component visibility. Fiscal year and login IP ranges are Setup/security settings outside Lightning App Builder.

topic: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder
question: A custom serial number must be unique and usable for integrations. What should the admin configure?
options: Text field marked Unique and External ID
answers: Text field marked Unique and External ID
explanation: A text field marked Unique prevents duplicates and External ID indexes it for integrations and matching. Long Text Area is not suitable as a unique integration key, Auto-number generates values automatically, and formula fields are not used the same way as external IDs.

topic: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder
question: A roll-up summary is needed on Account to count related custom records. The child uses Lookup to Account. What is true?
explanation: Standard roll-up summary fields require a master-detail relationship. They do not work across ordinary lookup relationships. Page layouts and record types do not change relationship behavior.

topic: Object Manager and Lightning App Builder
question: Users should see key fields at the top of mobile and Lightning record pages. What should be configured?
explanation: Compact layouts control key fields shown in highlights panels and mobile headers. Sharing rules control record access, queues hold work, and validation rules enforce data quality.

question: An admin needs to import 40,000 Leads and prevent duplicates by email. Which tool is best?
explanation: Data Import Wizard is appropriate for 40,000 Leads and includes duplicate handling. Data Loader can load large data but does not provide the same guided duplicate prevention. Schema Builder and Report Builder are not import tools.

question: An admin needs to update 250,000 Account records using record IDs. Which tool is best?
explanation: Data Loader is best for high-volume updates using IDs. Data Import Wizard is more limited and less suitable for 250,000 updates. App Launcher and dashboards do not perform bulk updates.

question: Users must not save Opportunities with Close Date in the past unless Stage is Closed Won or Closed Lost. What should enforce this?
explanation: Validation rules prevent bad data from being saved. Dashboard filters affect analytics, page layouts affect UI, and Chatter supports collaboration.

question: A report must show Accounts with and without Opportunities. What should be created?
options: Custom report type with Accounts with or without Opportunities
answers: Custom report type with Accounts with or without Opportunities
explanation: Custom report types can include parent records with or without child records. The standard Accounts with Opportunities report only shows Accounts that have Opportunities. Joined reports can help in some cases but are not the cleanest single-list design. Dashboard filters only affect dashboard data.

question: A dashboard should show results based on the viewing user’s access. What should be used?
explanation: Dynamic dashboards run as the viewer and respect that viewer's access. Static dashboards use one running user, bucket fields group report data, and tabular report is a report format.

question: Which two features help prevent dirty data?
explanation: Duplicate rules identify or block duplicate records, and validation rules enforce data quality. Compact layouts and Chatter groups do not prevent bad data.

question: A manager wants to group Opportunity Amounts into Small, Medium, and Large directly in a report. What should be used?
explanation: Bucket fields group report values without creating fields on the object. Record types classify business processes, queues hold work, and permission sets grant access.

question: A company needs weekly backup files including Salesforce data. What native feature should be used?
explanation: Data Export Service creates scheduled export files for backup. Report subscriptions send report results, Data Import Wizard imports data, and approval processes route approvals.

question: A custom Lead field should map to a custom Opportunity field during conversion. Where is this configured?
explanation: Custom Lead fields can be mapped to Account, Contact, or Opportunity custom fields during conversion using Lead Field Mapping. Page layouts only change UI, validation rules block saves, and campaign settings manage marketing.

question: A dashboard component shows different numbers for different users. The dashboard is set to run as the viewer. Why?
options: Dynamic dashboards respect each viewer’s data access
Matrix reports cannot be used in dashboards
answers: Dynamic dashboards respect each viewer’s data access
explanation: Different users see different dashboard results when the dashboard runs as the viewer because the dashboard respects each viewer's data access. Dashboards can cache data, reports respect sharing, and matrix reports can be used in dashboards.

question: When an Opportunity is Closed Won, create an onboarding record and notify finance. What automation should be used?
explanation: Record-triggered Flow is the modern automation tool for record-triggered creation and notifications. Workflow Rules and Process Builder are legacy for new automation. Assignment rules route records.

question: A field on the same record must be updated before save for best performance. What flow optimization should be used?
explanation: Before-save flows are best for updating fields on the triggering record efficiently. After-save flows are for related records and actions, screen flows require user interaction, and scheduled flows run on a schedule.

question: Discount requests over 25% require manager approval. What should the admin configure?
explanation: Approval processes route records for formal approval. Auto-response rules send automatic responses, case escalation rules escalate cases, and duplicate rules handle duplicate records.

question: A flow must send an email 7 days after a Case is closed. What should be used?
explanation: Scheduled paths run actions relative to a date or time after the trigger. Immediate actions run immediately, assignment elements only store values, and validation rules block saves.

question: Which two are valid Flow actions?
explanation: Flow can create or update records and send email actions. Changing Salesforce edition and disabling organization-wide defaults are org-level administrative changes, not normal Flow actions.

question: A flow is not firing during testing. What should the admin check first?
options: Whether the user owns the record
explanation: Inactive flows do not run. Record ownership, dashboard refresh, and Chatter may matter in other contexts but are not the first check for a non-firing flow.

question: A user must enter Loss Reason when Opportunity Stage becomes Closed Lost. What is the simplest enforcement?
explanation: A validation rule is the simplest way to require Loss Reason when Stage is Closed Lost. Report types, dashboard components, and queues do not enforce required data at save.

question: Cases unresolved after 4 business hours should escalate to Tier 2. What should be configured?
explanation: Case Escalation Rules handle time-based case escalation. Campaign Members are marketing, forecast categories are sales forecasting, and lead conversion is for converting prospects.

question: An admin wants to test a Flow without permanently changing data. What should be used?
explanation: Flow debugger with rollback allows testing without permanent data changes. Data Loader, Report Builder, and Schema Builder do not provide this Flow testing behavior.

question: Marketing wants to track which Leads and Contacts attended webinars. What should be used?
explanation: Campaign Members track Lead and Contact participation and status in campaigns. Opportunity Products track products on deals, and Case Teams or Account Teams are team-sharing features.

question: A sales rep needs to track revenue, close date, and stage. What object is used?
explanation: Opportunities track potential revenue, stage, probability, and close date. Cases are for service, Campaigns are for marketing, and Assets track purchased assets.

question: A Lead is converted. Which two records are commonly created?
explanation: Lead conversion commonly creates an Account and Contact; Opportunity is optional. Cases and dashboards are not standard lead conversion outputs.

question: Sales reps need guided fields and coaching by Opportunity Stage. What should be used?
explanation: Path provides stage-based guidance and key fields. Queues route ownership, Knowledge stores support content, and Entitlements relate to service SLAs.

question: A product cannot be added to a custom price book. What should the admin check first?
options: Product has an active Standard Price Book entry
answers: Product has an active Standard Price Book entry
explanation: A product generally needs an active standard price before use in custom price books. Opportunity ownership, active Campaigns, and Case assignment rules do not resolve missing price book entry issues.

question: Support agents need to track customer issues. What object is used?
explanation: Cases track customer service issues. Opportunities are sales, Campaigns are marketing, and Leads are pre-sales prospects.

question: Incoming cases should be routed to the right team. Which two features help?
explanation: Assignment rules route cases and queues hold cases for teams. Forecasting and Opportunity splits are sales features.

question: Agents need searchable approved articles for common issues. What should be used?
explanation: Salesforce Knowledge stores approved searchable support articles. Campaign Influence tracks marketing influence, Data Loader loads data, and Path guides stages.

question: Customers should submit and track cases through a portal. What should be used?
explanation: Experience Cloud supports customer portals for case submission and tracking. Data Import Wizard, Schema Builder, and Forecasting do not create customer portals.

question: High-priority cases must show SLA countdowns. What should be configured?
explanation: Entitlements define support terms and milestones track SLA targets. Campaign Members, Duplicate Rules, and Opportunity Teams are unrelated to SLA countdowns.

question: Sales managers want to split revenue credit between two reps. What should be used?
explanation: Opportunity Teams identify collaborators and Splits divide credit. Case Teams are for support, Lead Queues route leads, and Public Groups group users for sharing and collaboration.

question: Customers should receive an automatic email when they submit a case. What should be configured?
explanation: Case Auto-Response Rules send immediate emails based on case criteria. Opportunity Splits, Forecasting, and Report subscriptions do not send case acknowledgments.

question: A company wants an AI agent to answer customer questions and retrieve Salesforce record data securely. What should be configured?
options: Agentforce actions connected to approved Flows or prompts
answers: Agentforce actions connected to approved Flows or prompts
explanation: Agentforce agents act through configured actions and governed prompts or Flows. Public report links expose data poorly, unrestricted API users violate least privilege, and manual email templates cannot retrieve live CRM data intelligently.

question: An admin needs reusable AI-generated sales emails grounded in Lead fields. What should be used?
explanation: Prompt Builder creates reusable grounded prompt templates. Classic Email Templates are static, Assignment Rules route records, and Data Loader loads data.

question: Which concept helps protect sensitive data when generative AI is used in Salesforce?
explanation: The Einstein Trust Layer helps protect data and enforce secure AI interactions. Public Groups, Compact Layouts, and Case Teams are standard platform features but not AI trust architecture.

question: An AI agent gives weak troubleshooting answers. The company already has approved Knowledge articles. What should the admin do?
options: Ground the agent with relevant Knowledge content
answers: Ground the agent with relevant Knowledge content
explanation: Grounding improves accuracy by giving the agent approved source material. Disabling escalations prevents useful handoffs, making articles public read/write is insecure, and removing topics eliminates structure.

question: Which two should admins do before deploying Agentforce capabilities?
options: Give all users Modify All Data
explanation: Admins should validate outputs and ensure data access is appropriate before deploying AI capabilities. Disabling validation rules weakens controls, and giving all users Modify All Data is dangerous over-permissioning.

question: Users want posts, comments, and mentions on records. What feature supports this?
explanation: Chatter supports posts, comments, mentions, and feeds. Data Loader loads data, Approval Process automates approvals, and Forecasting supports sales projections.

question: A private project team needs a collaboration space for files and discussions. What should be created?
explanation: Private Chatter Groups restrict collaboration to members. Public report folders share reports, Campaigns track marketing efforts, and queues route records.

question: Sales reps want emails and calendar events synced from Gmail or Outlook. What feature is commonly used?
explanation: Einstein Activity Capture can sync email and calendar activity depending on configuration. Schema Builder designs schema, Data Export Service exports data, and Case Escalation Rules escalate cases.

question: A rep needs to track a follow-up call and a future meeting. Which two activity records are used?
explanation: Tasks track to-dos and follow-ups, while Events track meetings. Campaign Members track campaign participation, and Price Books store product pricing.

question: Support agents want to perform repeated console actions with one click. What should be used?
explanation: Macros automate repeated console actions. Validation Rules enforce data quality, Duplicate Rules manage duplicates, and Forecast Categories support sales forecasting.

question: Mobile users need a quick action available from the mobile navigation experience. Where should the admin configure this?
explanation: Salesforce Mobile App Navigation controls quick access items in the Salesforce mobile experience. Data Loader, Report Builder, and Case Auto-Response Rules are unrelated.
